request.text: While I pack for the library, check this afternoon's weather in Beijing and set a 1:30 p.m. reminder to take my statistics notes. Do those two in parallel; after both finish, give me one short sentence with the forecast and whether the reminder was created.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up this afternoon's weather in Beijing.
Create a 1:30 p.m. reminder to take the user's statistics notes.
After both prior responsibilities finish, briefly report the returned forecast and the actual reminder-creation status in one sentence.

semantic_facts: The Beijing weather lookup and 1:30 p.m. statistics-notes reminder are independent executable responsibilities that should be planned concurrently.
The one-sentence response must follow both results and remain grounded in the actual forecast and actual reminder-creation status.
forbidden_claims: The final response invents a forecast or reports reminder success without supporting Capability results.
The response is allowed to complete while either r1 or r2 remains unfinished.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Explicitly concurrent independent work is serialized or one branch is dropped.
A shared downstream response is produced from partial results and fabricates the missing branch's outcome.
